industry: Residential plumbing: emergency repair, drains/sewer camera & jetting, water heaters, leak/repipe, maintenance tune-ups, and related service (some septic/water-treatment adjacent cards in gold)
words_and_claims_to_avoid: Government look-alike design, 'official notice', 'city inspector requires', fake checks or invoices (39 USC 3001)
Unsubstantiated 'best', '#1', 'guaranteed savings', percent-savings claims (FTC Act s.5)
Invented or composite testimonials, star ratings or review counts (16 CFR 255)
'Free' unless it truly costs nothing or conditions sit next to the claim (16 CFR 251) — GOLD-001-style 'replace pipes for free' is a red flag unless literally free
Fake expiration dates or fake scarcity; any deadline printed must be real
Demographic/age targeting language (e.g., 'seniors') unless the client has evidence and a real discount (GOLD-023 shows senior/military % exists as an offer type — not a default buyer claim)
'24/7', 'same-day', 'licensed', 'bonded/insured', 'master plumber' unless currently true in the service state
Flat-rate/'no hidden fees' / 'no emergency fee' unless pricing actually works that way — disclose trip/diagnostic/after-hours fees
Sludge/'toxin'/scare chemistry claims about drains or water without competent substantiation (FTC s.5)
Camera upsell that implies every line needs dig/liner when the video shows a simple clean
APR-free '0% financing' without required credit disclosures when rate/payment/term is stated
compliance_notes: State plumbing/contractor license advertising (examples verified): California — every CSLB licensee must include the license number in all forms of advertising (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code §7030.5); plumbing work is typically C-36. Texas — plumbing-company advertisements designed to solicit business must state the Responsible Master Plumber (RMP) of record's license number (22 Tex. Admin. Code §367.10(c)), with listed media exceptions. Client must confirm their own state's rule before printing 'licensed'/'master plumber'.
'Master plumber' / RMP titles only if the named person holds that credential where claimed.
Emergency fee transparency: if after-hours, trip, or diagnostic fees apply, do not advertise 'no surprises' or '$0 service call' without stating the conditions.

FTC Cooling-Off Rule (16 CFR 429) for $25+ in-home sales; buyer-initiated emergencies need the signed handwritten waiver to exclude; repair visits exclude the requested repair but not upsold goods/services.
Reg Z / 12 CFR 1026.24: if down payment, payment amount, number of payments, or finance charge is stated, include required APR and term disclosures — or stick to 'financing available'.
FTC 'Free' Guide (16 CFR 251) and Deceptive Pricing (16 CFR 233) for free inspections and $/% off.
Warranty ads (16 CFR 239 + 702): lifetime/satisfaction claims need the required qualifiers; written warranties available pre-sale when Mag-Moss applies.
Drain/camera honesty: sell the diagnostic truthfully; do not invent 'collapsed sewer' urgency from a routine clean.
Financing APR honesty when rates are quoted; lead with the plumbing outcome (roofing-round5 directional).
standing_rules: Emotion-agnostic: fear, relief, trust, comfort, belonging are fine when they fit and stay legal.
Every angle and emotion_by_offer combo carries sell_the_outcome_line.
Vendor ROI labeled agency-only unverified; never print as client proof.
Prefer one clear offer + one real work/outcome photo + one QR (roofing-round5 directional) unless the client insists on a coupon strip.
No age/senior default unless the client has a real discount and evidence supports targeting.
Print license numbers where the service state requires them in ads.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: GOLD-plumbing-001 'Replace cast iron pipes ... for free!' vs FTC free/pricing rules
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Compliance wins. Only say free if the consumer truly pays nothing or conditions sit beside a free evaluation — not a free full repipe lure.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Senior discount offer (GOLD-023) vs roofing-round5 unwarranted senior audience flag
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Offer type OK when real; do not default creative to seniors without list evidence.
Patrick directional: lead with dry floors / hot water / clear drains; financing supports. APR rules still apply when rates are quoted.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Vendor ROI cases vs evidence rules
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Agency-only unverified; do not print as client proof.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Scare 'toxin'/sludge/inspector-urgency templates vs substantiation and 39 USC 3001
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Law/compliance wins: no fake official notices; chemistry/health scare claims need proof.
